item.title: Draft housing ordinance amendments to raise the single-parent income deduction
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism published a draft amending ministerial ordinance for public comment on 2026-11-10, with a stated deadline of 2026-12-10 23:59 JST. It would raise the single-parent deduction from JPY 350,000 to JPY 380,000 in income calculations used for housing eligibility and rent calculations under four sets of regulations covering specified quality rental housing, disaster-prevention block development in densely built-up urban areas, elderly housing, and rental housing for people requiring special consideration in securing housing. These include the Enforcement Regulations of the Act on Promotion of Supply of Specified Quality Rental Housing (Act No. 52 of 1993). The proposed schedule gives promulgation in late December 2026 and commencement on 2028-01-01; neither is presented as completed. Transitional provisions would apply the revised deduction to specified quality rental housing income calculations performed on or after 2028-07-01, retaining the previous rules for those performed earlier; the excerpts do not establish the complete transitional arrangements for all four schemes. Original title: 特定優良賃貸住宅の供給の促進に関する法律施行規則等の一部を改正する省令案に関する意見募集について Public Comment Open | e-Gov Public Comment | Published 2026-11-10 | First detected 2026-11-11 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-10, the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare published a warning concerning RR Roll-On, an 88 mL CBD product, lot M1500RO924, in which testing detected delta-9 THC above the 0.10 ppm residual limit. The notice identifies the product as a narcotic under the Narcotics and Psychotropics Control Act and warns against sale, transfer, purchase, possession and use. item.title: Draft Cabinet Order on Priority Industrial Technologies and Economic Security
item.description: AI summary: The draft Cabinet Order would designate priority industrial technologies in six fields: artificial intelligence and advanced robotics; quantum technology; semiconductors and communications; biotechnology and healthcare; fusion energy; and space activities. It would amend the Enforcement Order of the Industrial Technology Enhancement Act by adding this designation and specifying the responsible ministers for listed industrial technology research corporations, while updating statutory cross-references. It would also amend the Economic Security Promotion Act Enforcement Order's provision concerning inventions referred to the Prime Minister, including references governing patent rights retained for government-commissioned research and software development. The Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry published the draft and related proposed rules, guidelines and examination criteria for public comment on 2026-11-09; the stated deadline was 2026-12-08 23:59 JST. The listed contacts are the Research and Development Division and University Collaboration Promotion Office of the ministry's Innovation and Environment Bureau.
